snippet.title: Paunchy Pets // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4052150/Paunchy_Pets

Paunchy Pets are your chubby little monsters that love to battle almost as much as they love to eat. Train them in flash-style mini-games, Feed them junk food in a cozy farming sim, Battle opponent’s pets in an autobattler based on skill, and Breed rare Paunchies to bolster your roster.

👥 Players: Single Player, Online PvP
🛠️ Developer: Doonamai, LLC, Tideturners
📚 Publisher: Doonamai, LLC
📅 Release Date: Oct 6, 2026
🎯 Genre: Action, Casual, Indie, RPG, Simulation
